source: EDGAR submissions API; 8-K filings carrying Item 2.02 (Results of Operations) for watchlist tickers with an expected date in the window
note: Records THAT a filing exists (accession + URL), never its content. `overdue` means the expected date passed by more than 2 sessions with nothing on EDGAR: either the date is wrong or the print was missed. Public repo: tickers, accessions and filing dates only.
